about: Leads for the pipeline: instruments suggested in GitHub issues and accepted by a maintainer, and leads a maintainer added with `pipeline.py leads --add`. `pipeline.py new --type discover --leads pipeline/leads.json` takes the queued ones. Written by tools/pipeline.py intake and leads.

leads.lead: Florida HB 919 (2024), Artificial Intelligence Use in Political Advertising
leads.why: Disclosure of AI-generated content in political advertising; listed as in effect in a law-firm tracker.
Creates the Government Technology Modernization Council on AI and other technologies; listed in a law-firm tracker for AI-generated child sexual abuse material.

leads.lead: Florida CS/CS/SB 262 (2023), technology transparency (Florida Digital Bill of Rights), Laws of Florida ch. 2023-201
leads.why: Listed in a law-firm tracker for automated decision-making; mainly a privacy and technology-transparency law, so the run decides scope against pipeline/scope-decisions.md.

leads.lead: Executive Order 13859 (2019): Maintaining American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
leads.why: Pre-2023 instrument missing from the register: the first US executive order on AI, with guidance on AI regulation and technical standards.

leads.lead: Executive Order 13960 (2020): Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government
leads.why: Pre-2023 instrument missing from the register: principles for trustworthy AI use by federal agencies.

leads.lead: Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI (2019), High-Level Expert Group on AI, published by the European Commission
leads.why: Pre-2023 instrument missing from the register: the Commission-convened expert group's guidelines that the AI Act builds on.

leads.lead: New Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan (State Council, Guofa [2017] No. 35)
leads.why: Pre-2023 instrument missing from the register: China's 2017 national AI plan, with goals for AI laws, ethics and safety assessment. Also in the State Council Gazette 2017 No. 22: https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5216427.htm

leads.lead: Communication: Artificial Intelligence for Europe, COM(2018) 237 (European Commission, 25 Apr 2018)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). The Commission's first AI strategy, including the ethical and legal framework that led to the HLEG guidelines.

leads.lead: Coordinated Plan on Artificial Intelligence, COM(2018) 795 (European Commission, 7 Dec 2018)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). Joint plan of the Commission and member states, with ethics guidelines and trustworthy AI as one of its aims; reviewed in 2021.

leads.lead: Charlevoix Common Vision for the Future of Artificial Intelligence (G7 leaders, 9 Jun 2018)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). G7 leaders' commitment to human-centric AI, with safeguards for privacy, security and bias.

leads.lead: European Ethical Charter on the use of Artificial Intelligence in judicial systems and their environment (CEPEJ, Council of Europe, 4 Dec 2018)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). Five ethical principles for AI in justice. coe.int blocks the archiver (Cloudflare), so the run may need a provided document.

leads.lead: Strategie Künstliche Intelligenz der Bundesregierung (Federal Government AI Strategy, Nov 2018; Bundestag Drucksache 19/5880)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). Germany's national AI strategy, adopted by the cabinet on 15 Nov 2018, with sections on ethics, regulation and AI safety.

leads.lead: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence #AIforAll (NITI Aayog, Jun 2018, discussion paper)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). India's first national AI strategy paper, including a chapter on ethics, privacy and security; a discussion paper, so probably in with a scope note.

leads.lead: French national AI strategy 'AI for Humanity' (Mar 2018)
leads.why: 2018 instrument missing from the register (no records dated 2018). Announced on 30 Mar 2018 on the basis of the Villani report; ethics is one of its priorities, so probably in with a scope note.
